@@note: German. A machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker. Made from the mobile app's translations (mstream_music, master at bdb174e, lib/l10n/app_de.arb, GPL-3.0) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, main at b89ad0a, locales/de.yml, GPL-3.0-only; both by this repository's owner) where they had the text or its words: du, „…“, Titel, Album, Künstler, Ordner, Bibliothek, Warteschlange, Abspielen, Als Nächstes, Zufallswiedergabe, Kopfhörer, gekoppelt, Verbinden, Trennen, Vergessen, Akku, Karte, Sleep-Timer, Touch-Kalibrierung, Erneut versuchen, Speichern, Fertig. Translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise, then reviewed by a second Fable agent (meaning against each text's context, terms, grammar and plurals, register, typography, the rooms). Notes in "@<id>" say where a shorter word replaced the apps' one for the room, and which texts are marked overflow until a layout fix.

@tabs.library.note: 'Bibliothek' (the apps' word, and the tab's name in coach.tab_more, library.crumb and empty.open_library) is 66 px in Small, the tab label's room 52 px (Output's is 64). 'Musik' (38 px) would fit, but would name the tab otherwise than the texts that point to it. Layout: let the active tab's label spill over its neighbours, which show only icons (the label row under them is free), or draw no label where it doesn't fit (the icon says it).

@tabs.queue.note: 'Warteschlange' (the apps' word) is 97 px in Small, the room 52 px; German has no natural short form ('Queue', 42 px, is an anglicism; 'Liste', 31 px, is vague). Layout: as tabs.library, let the active tab's label spill over its icon-only neighbours (97 px needs about 20 px each side), or draw no label where it doesn't fit.

@toast.undo.note: 'Rückgängig' (the standard German for Undo) is 103 px in Bold, the button 50 px; 'Zurück' (62 px) would still overflow and reads as 'back'; 'Undo' (46 px) fits but is an anglicism the clear dialog's body would then have to quote. Layout: the toast already has a compact mode (Overlays.cpp: the Undo and View buttons as icons, the note on two lines at its ': ') for a note that doesn't fit beside the buttons; use it too when a button's label doesn't fit its button.

@toast.view.note: 'Zeigen' is 61 px in Bold, the button 52 px ('Sehen' 56, 'Öffnen' 61; 'Liste', 44 px, fits but is vague). Layout: as toast.undo, the compact mode's icons when a label doesn't fit.

@volume.label.note: 'Lautstärke' is 69 px in Small, the test's room 66 px (what 'Headphones' in Bold and '100%' leave; Overlays.cpp computes it from the name and the value: with 'Lautsprecher' it is 58 px at 100% and 73 px below, with 'Kopfhörer' 87 px or more, so the device cuts it only on the speaker at 100%). 'Volumen' (58 px) isn't what German audio UIs say; 'Pegel' (36 px) is the engineer's word. Layout: 3 px more for the test's figure, 11 for the speaker at 100%; or draw the label (dim, secondary) only when it fits.

@library.action_queue.note: '+ Queue' as a verb: 'Einreihen' (to put into the queue, as VLC's German says for Enqueue) is 75 px in the 77 px button; 'Hinzufügen' is 90 px. The toast says 'Hinzugefügt: …'.

@library.play_all.note: 'Alle {0} abspielen' (the apps' 'Alle abspielen' with the count) is 186 px in the 123 px button at 19410 and 175 at 1234: cut on most cards, where the English (126 px at 19410, marked in en.json) is cut only at five digits. '{0} spielen' fits to four digits (114 px) and is 125 px at 19410, the English's own case; 'one' says '1 Titel spielen' (127 px: 'Alle 1 abspielen' and '1 spielen' aren't German), 4 px over only on a card with a single track. 'Alle spielen' (103 px) would fit at every count but drop the count the English shows.

@library.crumb.note: 'Bibliothek' is 90 px in Bold, the pill's budget 80 px (Ui::drawHeader sizes the pill by its label and the chevron, and the title gets the rest: the device draws it whole and the title loses 10 px). German has no shorter name for the Library ('Start', 47 px, is the web's breadcrumb root, but names nothing here). Layout: 10 px of the title's budget, or a Small fallback for the pill (66 px).

@library.various_artists.note: The mobile app's 'Verschiedene Interpreten' is 205 px in Body, the room 190 px; 'Künstler' is the device's word for an artist anyway.

@queue.edit.note: 'Wählen' (select: the pill enters selection mode) is 67 px in Bold, the pill's budget 60 px; 'Ändern' is 64, the mobile app's 'Bearbeiten' 90; 'Wahl' (45 px) and 'Wähle' (56 px) aren't button labels; 'Edit' (35 px) would fit. QueuePage.cpp sizes the pill by its label and picks the summary that fits the rest, so the device draws it whole and the summary has 7 px less (the German summaries are short).
